title: castilleja miniata subsp. elata
intro: Castilleja miniata subsp. elata, commonly known as Indian paintbrush or red paintbrush, is a flowering plant native to the western regions of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis, coughs, and congestion, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Castilleja miniata subsp. elata are attributed to its ability to stimulate the respiratory system and reduce inflammation, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
